notes: The table on sheet 'Report' starts at header row 4 and has 12 data rows (rows 5–16); the sheet has 18 rows, so the trailing row(s) are the TOTAL line the operator said to exclude, not a product record.

No currency column exists inside the table. The merged heading cells A1:D1 and A2:D2 sit above the table and are the likely place where the workbook states the applicable currency and the quantity basis; the ISO 4217 code for /currency must be read from that heading (or confirmed) rather than inferred from the numeric values.
SKU values are zero-padded text in the source (000001…000012) but were profiled as int; the mapping must read them as text so leading zeros are preserved.

Prices are bare numbers with no VAT/tax marker and no explicit VAT statement in the table; nothing supports assuming VAT-inclusive or VAT-exclusive pricing, so no VAT adjustment should be applied without an explicit source statement or operator decision.
All four table columns map cleanly to required target fields; there are no unmapped source attributes in this table, so attributes_passthrough is not needed.

tables.reason: Sheet title 'Inventory and price list'; header row 4 has one distinct SKU per row (12/12 unique), a product name, a selling price and a stock quantity. It carries both a price and a stock figure, so it is a combined inventory/price list; inventory is chosen as the dominant role because stock is present, with pricing as the secondary aspect.
